Closing verification (sanctioned non-force path), main @9bdb22f5887.

TICKED AC1 ('the disagreement is resolved at its source ... with the choice justified'), with a correction to its premise: the disagreement was NOT a key-space mismatch. The reconstructed table IS keyed by backend name and DOES include engine_b.BACKEND_METRIC ('metric') — but only when no metric tool is on PATH, because the tiny mixed fixture is below the metric threshold, so an INSTALLED scc/lizard yields no metric evidence record at all. The real disagreement was between the test and its host environment. Resolved at source on the test side by commit 81b3b5929423a641cbf9dbf806796599df01d59f (canonical ticket 8322-6f05-ea1b-4da1, closed): tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py:100 pins engine_b._METRIC_CANDIDATES to a missing tool, matching the control its sibling test_metric_backend_skip_is_reconstructable already used. Production grounding behavior and the evidence schema were deliberately left unchanged (justification recorded on 8322's plan). Verified now: pytest tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py -q -> 5 passed, with the AC5 table printing 'metric ran=0 skipped=1 reasons={no_tool: 1}'.

LEFT UNTICKED — AC2 ('pytest -m "not integration and not external" is green at HEAD'): the cell this ticket reports is green, but the marker suite as a whole is not. Full run at 9bdb22f5887: 10821 passed, 18 failed, 789s, zero grounding/coverage-reconstruction failures. 17 of the 18 are artifacts of this venv or of a concurrent agent (missing 'ddgs' optional dep x9; stale botocore 1.40.61 < 1.43.64 x5; stale ruff 0.15.19 vs pinned 0.16.1 x1; criteria-vocabulary scan reaching into .claude/worktrees/ x1). One is genuine and standalone-reproducible on a clean tree: tests/unit/test_path_injection_guards.py::test_rerun_502_body_has_no_exception_detail — AttributeError: 'types.SimpleNamespace' object has no attribute 'headers' (src/rebar/review_bot/app.py:101 _request_token reads request.headers; the test's fake request lacks it). Unrelated to this ticket, so I did not assert 'green'.
